'''Free Spirit''' is a tier two [[technology]] that unlocks the [[Temples|Temple]], an expensive [[building]] whose [[Score|point value]] increases over time, and the the [[Disband]] ability, which removes a [[unit]] and returns half of its cost, rounded down.  

==Free Diving==

[[Aquarion]] has the '''Free Diving''' technology instead of Free Spirit. Free Diving unlocks [[movement]] in ocean as well as the Temple and Disband.
